scripts.title: makes your character to dark skin tone | switching teams
scripts.features:
well well well open source

how to use

read script
scripts.script:
local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local plr = plrs.LocalPlayer

-- well well well
-- made by proohio
-- very pro
-- https://proohio.click/

local function changerace()
	local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local c = Color3.fromRGB(88, 61, 52)
	for i, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name ~= "Head" then
			v.Color = c
		end
	end
	if char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
		char.Head.Color = c
	end
end
changerace()

scripts.title: teleport tool
scripts.features:
teleport tool very pro and opensource

how to use

execute and equip the tool and click somewhere and boom
scripts.script:
local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local plr = plrs.LocalPlayer
local m = plr:GetMouse()
local tool = Instance.new("Tool") 

tool.Name = "proohio tool"
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = plr.Backpack

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if m.Target then
		local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		if char then
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = hum.RootPart
			if root then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(m.Hit.p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: teleport
scripts.features:
teleport open source very pro

how to use 

read script
scripts.script:
local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local plr = plrs.LocalPlayer

local targetname = "targetname" -- Change this to your target

-- very pro
-- made by proohio
-- https://proohio.click/

local function teleportToTarget()
	local tplr = plrs:FindFirstChild(targetname)
	if tplr and tplr.Character then
		local pchar = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local tchar = tplr.Character
		local proot = pchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local troot = tchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if proot and troot then
			proot.CFrame = troot.CFrame
		end
	end
end

teleportToTarget()

scripts.title: chat spammer
scripts.features:
chat spammer very pro

how to use

read script
scripts.script:
local message = "a" -- message to spam

local speed = 1 -- Delay

getgenv().chatspammer = false -- Toggle true = spam false = no spam

-- made by proohio
-- very pro
-- https://proohio.click/

local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
ilc = tcs.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService
function chatMessage(str)
	str = tostring(str)
	if not ilc then
		tcs.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(str)
	else
		rs.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(str, "All")
	end
end
spawn(function()
	while getgenv().chatspammer do
		chatMessage(message)
		task.wait(speed)
	end
end)
